method: All-electron def2-SVP ROHF -> CASCI; CCSD(T) embedded in the IDENTICAL active space; selected-CI on the active-space qubit Hamiltonian. Apples-to-apples in-active-space comparison.
key_finding: On a real Cr-O bond stretch, in-active-space CCSD(T) develops a large, non-convergent error vs exact CASCI while selected-CI/QSCI stays variational and accurate.
honest_caveats: CCSD(T) is compared to FCI/CASCI in the SAME embedded active space (not full-molecule CCSD(T) vs small CAS).
On CrO the in-active-space CCSD(T) error stays ABOVE FCI (large + non-convergent), unlike H10 where it dipped below; framed accordingly.
CAS(10,10) in def2-SVP is a fixed, modest active space; the curve demonstrates the failure-mode contrast, not a benchmark-quality PES.
